jobs.title: Senior Backend - FastAPI & Python
jobs.description:
About the Role:


We are looking for a Senior FastAPI Developer with 35 years of hands-on experience in building scalable, secure, and high-performance backend applications.


Key Responsibilities:



Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend applications using Python and FastAPI.
Build clean, secure, well-documented REST APIs for web and frontend applications.
Design and optimize PostgreSQL databases, including schemas, relationships, indexes, and queries.
Work with Supabase for database, authentication, storage, and other backend services where required.
Deploy, manage, and maintain backend applications on AWS.
Develop scalable and maintainable backend architecture following industry best practices.
Implement authentication, authorization, validation, error handling, logging, and API security.
Optimize APIs, database queries, and backend services for performance and reliability.
Integrate third-party APIs and external services.
Work closely with frontend developers, product teams, and other engineers to deliver features.
Write clean, reusable, well-tested, and maintainable code.
Debug production issues and contribute to improving system stability and observability.
Participate in code reviews and help maintain engineering standards.

Mandatory Skills:


Candidates must have strong hands-on experience with:



Python
FastAPI
PostgreSQL
REST API development
AWS
Supabase

What We Are Looking For:



Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
Ability to independently design and implement backend features.
Good understanding of software architecture and backend best practices.
Strong ownership and attention to code quality.
Ability to collaborate effectively with frontend and product teams.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced product development environment.

Qualification:



Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is preferred.
3-5 years of professional backend development experience.
Strong production experience with Python + FastAPI + PostgreSQL + AWS + Supabase + REST APIs.
